title: The Telangana Mutually Aided Co-operative Societies Act, 1995.
full_text: The Telangana Mutually Aided Co-operative Societies Act, 1995. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 199530 Act Number: 30 Enactment Date: 1995-05-17 Act Year: 1995 Short Title: The Telangana Mutually Aided Co-operative Societies Act, 1995. Long Title: An Act to provide for the Voluntary formation of Co-operative Societies as accountable, competitive Self Reliant Business Enterprises, based on thrift self help and Mutual Aid and owned managed and controlled by Members for their Economic and Social betterment and for the matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
